primary_title: beta-Arrestin-1 mediates glucagon-like peptide-1 signaling to insulin secretion in cultured pancreatic beta cells
decision_basis: Primary evidence supports GLP-1R-beta-arrestin-1 association and bounded beta-cell signaling; review-to-primary lineage recorded.
limitations_preserved: Preserve INS-1 beta-cell context and the distinction between beta-arrestin-1 signaling association and universal internalization; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: G protein-coupled receptor kinase 2 and beta-arrestins are recruited to FSH receptor in stimulated rat primary Sertoli cells
decision_basis: Primary evidence supports FSH-dependent FSHR-beta-arrestin-1 recruitment in primary Sertoli cells; review-to-primary lineage recorded.
limitations_preserved: Preserve endogenous FSHR and rat Sertoli-cell context; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Structure of the neurotensin receptor 1 in complex with beta-arrestin 1
decision_basis: Primary cryo-EM evidence supports the phosphorylation-dependent NTSR1-beta-arrestin-1 structural complex; review-to-primary lineage recorded.
limitations_preserved: Preserve NTS(8-13), phosphorylated receptor, truncated beta-arrestin-1 and structural-only scope; no whole-cell, SCI or terminal-TF inference.
